task_description:
1. Coat -Coat a 6-oz. ramekin cup with cooking spray
2. Pour-Pour 1 egg into the ramekin cup
3. Microwave-Microwave the ramekin cup uncovered on high for 30 seconds
4. Cut -Cut the English muffin into two pieces with a knife
5. stir-stir the ramekin cup
6. Microwave -Continue to Microwave for 15-30 more seconds or until the egg is almost set
7. Top -Top cup with 1 tablespoon of salsa
8. sprinkle -sprinkle 1 tablespoon of cheese on cup
9. Microwave -Microwave just until cheese melts, about 10 seconds
10. Line -Line the bottom piece of the English muffin with lettuce
11. Place -Place the egg from the cup over the lettuce
12. replace -replace the top of the English muffin

task_description:
1. Place-Place 8-inch flour tortilla on cutting board
2. scoop-Use a butter knife to scoop nut butter from the jar
3. Spread-Spread nut butter onto the tortilla, leaving 1/2-inch uncovered at the edges
4. Clean-Clean the knife by wiping it with a paper towel
5. scoop-Use the knife to scoop jelly from the jar
6. Spread-Spread jelly over the nut butter
7. Clean-Clean the knife by wiping with a paper towel
8. Roll-Roll the tortilla from one end to the other into a log shape, about 1.5 inches thick. Roll it tight enough to prevent gaps, but not so tight that the filling leaks
9. Secure-Secure the rolled tortilla by inserting 5 toothpicks about 1 inch apart
10. Trim-Trim the ends of the tortilla roll with the butter knife, leaving 1/2 inch margin between the last toothpick and the end of the roll
11. Discard-Discard ends of the tortilla
12. Slide-Slide floss under the tortilla, perpendicular to the length of the roll
13. Place-Place the floss halfway between toothpicks
14. Cross-Cross the floss's two ends over the tortilla roll's top
15. pull-pull the floss ends in opposite directions to slice
16. slicing-Continue slicing with floss to create 1 more pinwheel
17. Place-Place the pinwheels on a plate

task_description:
1. Measure-Measure 12 ounces of cold water
2. Place-Place the dripper on top of a coffee mug
3. Weigh-Weigh the coffee beans (0.8oz-0.12 oz)
4. Grind-Grind the coffee beans until the coffee grounds are the consistency of coarse sand, about 20 seconds
5. Prepare-Prepare the filter insert by folding the paper filter in half to create a semi-circle, and in half again to create a quarter-circle
6. transfer-transfer water to a kettle
7. Place-Place the paper filter in the dripper
8. Boil-Boil the water. (While the water is boiling, assemble the filter cone)
9. spread-spread open filter in dripper to create a cone
10. check-Once the water has boiled, check the temperature of the water. (The water should be between 195-205 degrees Fahrenheit or between 91-96 degrees Celsius. If the water is too hot, let it cool briefly.)
11. Transfer-Transfer the grounds to the filter cone
12. Pour-Pour a small amount of water into the filter to wet the grounds
13. Wait-Wait about 30 seconds for the coffee to bloom. (You will see small bubbles or foam on the coffee grounds during this step.)
14. pour-Slowly pour the rest of the water over the grounds in a circular motion. Do not overfill beyond the top of the paper filter
15. drain-Let the coffee drain completely into the mug before removing the dripper
16. Discard-Discard the paper filter and coffee grounds

15. drain-Let the coffee drain completely into the mug before removing the dripper
16. Discard-Discard the paper filter and coffee grounds
